change.item: Added a second semantic badge showing the configured disabled reason.
Added lightweight Menu and filter accordion open animations with reduced-motion support.
Improved dark-mode contrast for SHORTCODE and INVII labels.
Removed card-title background in all themes.
Consolidated duplicate enabled/disabled badge CSS into canonical semantic rules.
Prevented generic Joomla dark badge rules from overriding form status colors.
Renamed the Forms list navigation action from Azioni to Menu.
Replaced the central modal with a compact anchored dropdown menu.
The navigation menu closes on outside click, selection, or Escape.
Shortened form action label from Modifica modulo to Modifica.
Renamed Vedi invii to Apri invii.
Unified smartphone filter controls to a 46-pixel height.

fix.item: Smartphone form-list actions now use the normal Joomla font size.
Active and inactive badges retain their semantic colours in both light and dark modes.
Dark primary form-list actions keep their dark red colour in the normal state.
Dark accent buttons now use the intended dark red variant.
Neutral form actions now provide visible hover and keyboard focus feedback.
Removed residual title-strip styling from form cards.

change.item: Smartphone header actions are displayed in two equal columns.
Search and filter accordion matches the main action controls.
Smartphone card actions use a consistent 46-pixel height.

fix.item: Forms list search now includes ID and shortcode.
Responsive layout now follows the component container width and avoids horizontal overflow.
Dark mode no longer shows light title bands or light filter panels.

change.item: Smartphone filters use an accordion and primary actions stack vertically.
Actions dialog uses one item per row.
Dark accent buttons use a darker variant for better contrast.

addition.item: One-click form duplication without copying submissions or files.
Actions dialog and real-time forms filters/sorting.

change.item: Removed Copy/Paste form workflow from the administrator UI.
Improved smartphone form-card layout and action placement.

addition.item: Copy form and paste form workflow in administrator.
Copy form action is also available from the form submissions page.

change.item: Pasted forms receive a new ID, slug and shortcode while preserving configuration and fields.
Submissions and uploaded files are deliberately excluded from copies.

addition.item: Live search while typing in Recent submissions and form submissions.
Immediate filtering when form, status or row-limit selectors change.

change.item: Standardised list filtering with a lightweight 180 ms debounce across administrator list views.

addition.item: Clickable summary cards that act as immediate status filters.
Export icons for CSV, Excel and PDF.

change.item: Forms list title aligned with the Elenco moduli menu label.
Back navigation moved into the submissions page header.
Larger live status badge moved into the Gestisci invio heading.

fix.item: Fixed PHP runtime error when opening a single submission from the administrator list.
Fixed status preview generation in the single-submission management panel.

addition.item: Configurable per-status badge colors with sensible defaults.
Summary cards, full filters and Back navigation on each form submissions page.
Recent submissions table column selector with remembered browser preference.

change.item: Table-column settings are displayed as one boxed row per column.
Status colors are shown consistently in lists and submission detail.

addition.item: Recent submissions dashboard with summary cards and combined filters.
Submission row selection and selected-only CSV, Excel and PDF export.
Two-column submission detail with management panel and internal note.
Email template modal preview built from the current form fields.

change.item: Simplified administrator terminology in Italian.
Table column configuration is presented as Colonne della tabella.
Saving a submission now closes the detail and returns to the submissions list.

addition.item: Email template cards are clickable and open a modal facsimile preview.
Single submission view now includes back navigation to the form submissions list.

change.item: Primary administrator actions use Joomla/Bootstrap button styling so colors adapt to the active administrator theme.
Email preview uses the configured Forms brand name and accent color.

addition.item: Dashboard with forms, active forms, submission totals and recent activity.
Per-form custom status workflows.
Per-form selectable submission-list columns, including form fields.
Full-width administrator layout.
Dark-mode support across all Forms administrator views.

change.item: The first configured status is assigned automatically to new submissions.
Submission filters and exports support custom technical status keys.
The main Forms administrator menu now opens the Dashboard.
Minimal maintenance release for testing Joomla automatic extension update detection from the GitHub package feed.
No database schema changes and no changes to existing form or submission data.

addition.item: Submissions export to Excel (.xlsx), CSV and PDF.
Exports respect the active search and status filters.

fix.item: Fixed status filtering so translated labels continue to use the correct technical status value.

security.item: Import operations require a Joomla CSRF token and core.create permission.

addition.item: Generic Data Import wizard for Joomla database tables, CSV/TSV, Google Sheets, Google Forms response sheets and external MySQL/MariaDB databases.
Source preview and column-to-field mapping.
Repeat-safe generic import log.

change.item: LSFS migration moved to an optional preset inside Data Import.
Localized component and package names in Italian, English and French.
